title: SEMANTIC PROPERTIES OF COSINE BASED BIAS SCORES FOR WORD EMBEDDINGS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and geometric properties of bias metrics (WEAT and Direct Bias) used to evaluate word embeddings and language models. While social bias is an ethical concern, the paper's focus is on the technical formalization and comparison of measurement scores rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems.
